description: Rothco’s Deluxe Chow Set is a must-have for any outdoor adventure, offering durability and convenience in a compact design. This 4-piece stainless steel utensil set includes a serrated knife, fork, spoon, and a combination can opener/bottle opener, ensuring you’re prepared for any meal on the go. Designed to fit together seamlessly, each piece connects into one easy-to-carry unit, saving space and keeping your utensils organized. The set comes with a compact storage pouch that fits effortlessly into a lunchbox, camping bag, or hiking pack, making it ideal for camping, picnics, or emergencies. With this durable and practical chow set, you can enjoy all the essentials for outdoor dining in one compact, reliable package.
